torch.Tensor.element_size
#
Tensor.
element_size
(
)
→
int
#
Returns the size in bytes of an individual element.
Example:
>>>
torch
.
tensor
([])
.
element_size
()
4
>>>
torch
.
tensor
([],
dtype
=
torch
.
uint8
)
.
element_size
()
1
